snippet.title: Mars Gardener – Trailer | Grow a posh suburban lawn on Mars
snippet.description:
Madame Odette, 74, hired for her hedges, must grow a posh suburban lawn on Mars.

Sow the red dust, water it, mow perfect stripes, and sell your turf bricks to rich colonists. Weather dust storms, moles and −80 °C nights, from nail scissors to a laser mower. The Red Planet will be green.

Mars Gardener comes to Steam on December 15, 2026 (€4.99 / $4.99), in English and French. Add it to your wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5547490/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

This cinematic trailer is staged with the game's own models; the game is played in first person.

Follow Forgeur Games on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/forgeurgames

#MarsGardener #IndieGame #CozyGames
